title: ADU Forecast for Queens parameters
$comment: Slider granularity is x-step, NOT multipleOf - see the bathtub schema for why. x-panel splits the controls in two: representation is how the map is drawn, assumptions is what the model is made of. x-shown-when removes a control that means nothing in the current view. The word "pencil" is the slug and appears nowhere a reader can see it.

view.title: Show
view.description: The tract view counts homes that pass all three tests. The lot view shows one test at a time, lot by lot. The 3D view draws a unit on every lot that has room for one and colors it by the other two tests.

tract_measure.title: Count as
tract_measure.description: A share divides the homes added by the homes the tract already has. A tract of large lots and few homes can show a high share from a small number.

test.title: Test
test.description: Each test is run only on the lots that passed the one before it. Red always means the lot fails the selected test.

grant_max.title: Maximum grant
grant_max.description: The term sheet's "$175,000 per grantee." At zero, no lot in Queens clears the loan ceiling, because the unit costs more to build than the program will lend.

equity_share.title: Homeowner's own money
equity_share.description: The share of the cost the owner pays in cash, which reduces the loan. The program does not require a contribution.

interest_rate.title: Interest rate
interest_rate.description: The term sheet's "5%. Rate may be reduced." The sheet allows a reduction to 0% for lower-income borrowers.

term_months.title: Loan term
term_months.description: The term sheet's "180 months (15 years)", extendable to 360.

cushion.title: Required monthly cushion
cushion.description: The term sheet sizes the loan so the household keeps "at least $200 monthly cash flow available." Here it is the amount the rent must clear after the payment and costs for the lot to pass.

cost_per_sf.title: Construction cost
cost_per_sf.description: The median of the eleven published cost midpoints in HPD's Pre-Approved Plan Library, which run from $248 to $1,500 per square foot.

rent_basis.title: What rent it gets
rent_basis.description: The program caps rent at 100% of area median income, one figure for the whole borough. Market rent is HUD's FY2026 Small Area Fair Market Rent for a one-bedroom, by ZIP. The cap is above market in most of Queens.

vacancy.title: Vacancy
vacancy.description: HPD's budgeting tool assumes 15% turnover. Rent is reduced by this share before costs.

rear_yard_denominator.title: One part in N of the rear yard
rear_yard_denominator.description: The Zoning Resolution allows a unit on "an area not exceeding one-third of the rear yard." This is the three, and it decides how many lots have room at all.

side_setback_ft.title: Side setback
side_setback_ft.description: The Zoning Resolution requires 5 feet from the rear and side lot lines. The setback decides whether a unit that passes the area test also fits on the ground.
